data.title: A neighbourhood clinic
data.description: Orvalha is a small outpatient clinic with seven specialties under one roof: family medicine, paediatrics, cardiology, dermatology, physiotherapy, nutrition and psychology.
data.heading: Unhurried care, close to home
data.intro: Seven specialties under one roof, a front desk that answers the same day, and appointments that start on time.
data.imageAlt: A receptionist at a light wood counter greeting a visitor in a bright reception with plants and tall windows.
data.visitBody:
Arrive ten minutes early and bring an identity document and any recent test results. The front desk opens your record while you wait.

The waiting area is on the ground floor, with water, a quiet corner for children and step-free access from the street.
data.visitImageAlt: A calm waiting area with green armchairs, a low wooden table with a water jug, plants and a large sunny window.

data.title: Services
data.description: The specialties at Orvalha, each described in a sentence or two.
data.intro: Every specialty is booked the same way: through the appointment form or at the front desk.

data.title: Our team
data.description: The doctors and therapists who see patients at Orvalha.
data.intro: Doctors and therapists who work together and share one record for each patient.
data.imageAlt: Three clinicians, two of them in white coats, talking together in a bright clinic corridor.

data.heading: How it works
data.body:
Tell us how to reach you and when you would prefer to come. The front desk calls or writes back within one working day to offer a time and the right specialty.

Please do not write about symptoms or health conditions here: you will talk about them in the appointment. In an emergency, call 192 or go to the nearest emergency department.

data.heading: Address and hours
data.body:
Rua das Paineiras, 214, Jardim do Orvalho.

  • Monday to Friday: 7:30 to 19:00
  • Saturday: 8:00 to 12:00
  • Sundays and public holidays: closed

Write to contact@orvalha.example. We answer within one working day.

data.heading: How to get here
data.body:
• By bus: the lines that stop at Praça das Paineiras leave you two minutes away on foot.
  • By car: four parking spaces behind the building, one of them reserved for people with reduced mobility.
  • By bicycle: there is a rack beside the entrance.

The entrance has a ramp beside the steps, and a lift goes to the first floor.

data.heading: A clinic made up for a sample
data.body:
Orvalha is invented. The clinic, its address and every person on this site are fictional, and no appointment made here is real. It is a sample site for Viglet Shio, the open-source CMS, installed from one marketplace package.

The photographs were generated for the package. The fonts are Plus Jakarta Sans and Inter, both under the SIL Open Font Licence and served from the site itself.
